title: Samurai sword clash
prompt: A premium photorealistic 5-second bullet-time demo. Two samurai swords collide in heavy rain and sparks burst between the fighters. At the peak action moment, time freezes almost completely: bodies, debris, droplets and secondary motion remain perfectly suspended. The camera perform a fast 220-degree orbit through suspended raindrops and sparks. In the final beat, normal time snaps back and the action resolves naturally. Same-moment 4D consistency, impossible viewpoint and crisp cinematic detail.
